listening.enter.mode_epoch: current server epoch; initial normal epoch is 0

sequence.scope: job trace; monotonically increasing; deterministic request_id
sequence.duplicates: same accepted seq and identical payload: return current state, no action; changed payload: reject; old evicted seq: reject, query state with a new seq

authorization: actual LiveKit participant equals expected dev-SN
strict worker service auth plus bound grant for internal HTTP
entry_completion: old capture tasks drained and Worker queue cleared
Android confirms local prompts and playback queues stopped

feedback.user_speaking: reject request while input active; new speech revokes reserved/active permit; speech_end never resumes cancelled output

lease.failure: do not extend; pause silently on expiry; old session closes before ordinary new session

ack.entry: received is not ready; completed follows Worker drain plus Android local_ready; the completed entry ACK echoes original enter request_id/command_seq
ack.state_query: new seq; returns current snapshot, never consumes another speech permit
ack.timeout_action: query state with a new seq; do not assume listening or resume local audio; close session if no trustworthy response

buffer.older_than_ledger: conservative summary invalidation and explicit context gap
buffer.summary_reply: bound to authenticated room/session/trace/listening_id plus retained ticket and buffer instance; stale reply rejected
buffer.gap: true for source loss OR unsummarized prefix omitted from recent context; never infer uninterrupted complete recall
